title: Glowing aeroplane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='44' ry='20' fill='#2a4a7a' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <polygon points='38,52 20,64 26,66 44,56' fill='#8fd0ff'/>
  <polygon points='38,48 20,36 26,34 44,44' fill='#bfe6ff'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <polygon points='74,50 88,40 90,44 78,52' fill='#5fb8ff'/>
  <!-- tail wing -->
  <polygon points='74,52 88,58 86,62 72,56' fill='#8fd0ff'/>
  <!-- fuselage -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='30' ry='9' fill='#e8f6ff'/>
  <!-- belly shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='28' ry='4' fill='#a9d8ff'/>
  <!-- cockpit window -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='48' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='47' rx='2' ry='1.3' fill='#bfe6ff'/>
  <!-- windows row -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='49' r='1.8' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <!-- engine under wing -->
  <rect x='40' y='57' width='12' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#5fb8ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='59.5' r='2.5' fill='#2f6fb0'/>
  <!-- nose light -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#bfffe0'/>
  <!-- speed streaks -->
  <rect x='6' y='47' width='9' height='1.6' rx='0.8' fill='#8fd0ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <rect x='4' y='52' width='12' height='1.6' rx='0.8' fill='#8fd0ff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
